blocks.text: A Dental CPA Can Provide Payroll Services for Dentist-Owners

Payroll services can take away valuable time from dentist-owners who already have full schedules. It also is a complex financial task, and errors can lead to fines or even civil or criminal charges. If you own your own dental practice and are concerned about how to manage your payroll, let an experienced dental CPA from Reliance Consulting, LLC, help. Our complete range of payroll services, tax preparation services, and many other accounting specialties can save you weeks of time per year and keep your businesses in compliance with tax regulations. With our payroll services saving you time and stress, you can concentrate on what you do best, which is running your practice and treating your patients.
The payroll services provided by your [dental CPA](http://reliancecpa.com/dental-cpa) from Reliance Consulting help you cover all the bases, including:

items.text: Timely, accurate paychecks for your employees
The ability to securely enter each employee’s hours and earnings online, and then print checks from your own printer
Or, if you prefer, direct deposit and pre-printed checks
Comprehensive payroll reports for your practice’s records
Maximum protection of all private, personal information
Fully compliant IRS, unemployment tax, and state payroll reporting
Unemployment claims, child support deductions, overtime, vacation time, and other individualized services

blocks.text: Our payroll services are among the most useful aids we provide our dental clients. When you need a dental CPA and accountant who can provide you and your workforce with compliant, reliable, and precise payroll processing, we are the firm you can depend on for outstanding, affordable results. For more details about our payroll services [contact](http://reliancecpa.com/contact.html) Reliance today.
